name: Masonry Gallery
summary: Multi-column image gallery with optional artwork overlays.

anatomy.name: piece
anatomy.description: Artwork presentation within an item; markup may remain passive or receive target-owned interaction semantics.

anatomy.name: image
anatomy.description: Artwork image supplied by the target.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Responsive one, two, and three-column masonry layout.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Column count adapts at the canonical responsive breakpoints.

states.name: pieceFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus and metadata disclosure for target-interactive artwork.

behavior.name: interactionBoundary
behavior.description: This contract does not decide whether a piece is passive, a link, or a lightbox trigger. Targets must use native interactive markup and corresponding keyboard behavior when interaction is added.

behavior.name: overlayDisclosure
behavior.description: Overlay metadata remains visible where hover is unavailable and is revealed by hover or focus-within on fine-pointer devices.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Target-owned ordered artwork items, including media and optional metadata.

accessibility: Give every meaningful artwork image useful alternative text and mark decorative images accordingly.
Do not communicate title or price only through a hover-exclusive overlay.
When a target makes a piece interactive, use a native link or button with a descriptive accessible name and visible focus.
Lightbox focus management, dismissal, and restoration belong to the composed Lightbox or target adapter, not this gallery contract.
